features.name: Meadow Lake and FDR Park Boathouse
features.description: Meadow Lake and the FDR Park Boathouse form the park's primary lake-view, fishing and program meeting area, with shoreline paths, no swimming and access that changes with flooding and restoration work.

details.imageAlt: Meadow Lake and FDR Park Boathouse at FDR Park

features.name: FDR Park Skatepark
features.description: FDR Park Skatepark is the world-known DIY concrete skate environment beneath I-95, with bowls, transitions and an industrial setting that is separate from the park's playground and lake recreation areas.

details.imageAlt: FDR Park Skatepark at FDR Park

features.name: American Swedish Historical Museum
features.description: The American Swedish Historical Museum is a separately operated, ticketed cultural destination inside FDR Park, with twelve galleries, its own Pattison Avenue entrance, museum hours and accessibility procedure.

details.imageAlt: American Swedish Historical Museum at FDR Park

features.name: Olmsted Overlook and Gazebo
features.description: Olmsted Overlook and its historic gazebo are a recognizable lake-side gathering landmark in FDR Park, used for views, informal rest and scheduled free music rather than as a staffed visitor center.
